Weekly security digest from the risk agent:

- 3 phishing pages asked users to reveal their recovery phrase; all three are now on the blocklist.
- Watch out for "reply with your private key to claim the airdrop" messages.
- e.g. attackers ask you to "sign this permit" for a fake refund.
- Drainer kits request unlimited token approvals to fresh contracts.

No action needed on your side. Your spending limits and presign-guard settings are unchanged.
